summary: Python Automation Engineer with 2+ years of experience building production-grade data pipelines and automation solutions for enterprise SaaS platforms, including shipping 729+ Python modules to production at MARKT-PILOT while contributing to a ~70% reduction in post-release defects. Delivered AI-powered automation through 700+ freelance projects (4.9/5 rating) using LLMs, RAG, LangChain, and LangGraph to solve real-world business challenges. Currently pursuing an MSc in Artificial Intelligence at the University of Jyväskylä, with a focus on building reliable AI systems that deliver measurable business impact.
